current_defect: One scalar program state per actor collapses hedging, hiding, sprinting, sheltered pursuit, coercive latency, weaponization, delivery, and deployment.
required_state: program_strategy; technical_latency_stage; political_legibility; coercive_leverage; delivery_readiness; survivability; concealment_mode
algorithmic_change: Replace scalar progress with a state machine and strategy-specific transition hazards.
acceptance_test: Historical replay correctly differentiates Japan, West Germany, Iraq, Libya, Iran, North Korea, and South Africa without manual outcome coding.

current_defect: Response resources are abstractly unlimited and threats do not queue.
required_state: inspector_capacity; analyst_capacity; legal_capacity; supplier_capacity; defensive_reinforcement_capacity; queue_length; service_time; N_minus_1_loss
algorithmic_change: Add a portfolio scheduler that allocates scarce capacity by conservative margin and value of information.
acceptance_test: System remains within target margins during three true threats, two decoys, one sensor outage, and loss of the largest supplier.

current_defect: Coercive advantage is treated as occurring after material weapon progress rather than at earlier bargaining stages.
algorithmic_change: Estimate time-to-coercive-advantage separately from time-to-device and time-to-operational-deterrent.
acceptance_test: Model reproduces cases where intermediate latency created leverage and cases where greater latency reduced bargaining success.

current_defect: Motivation is compressed into threat, prestige, grievance, and fuel demand.
required_state: security_need; strategic_opportunity; bureaucratic_interest; leader_identity; coalition_orientation; norm_internalization; status_need; regime_survival
algorithmic_change: Use motive vectors with actor-specific weights and interaction terms rather than a single propensity score.
acceptance_test: Calibration distinguishes cases with similar threats but divergent choices, including Australia/France, Argentina/India, Japan/North Korea, and Iraq/Libya.

current_defect: Evidence and communications are assumed intact and independent.
required_state: sensor_integrity; provenance_confidence; cyber_compromise; model_disagreement; communication_degradation; correlated_error
algorithmic_change: Introduce adversarial evidence corruption, sensor correlation, and degraded-mode adjudication.
acceptance_test: False-positive rate and response margin remain within thresholds under poisoned data, compromised telemetry, and one trusted-source failure.

current_defect: Interdiction has a mostly fixed grievance-and-delay effect.
required_state: intervention_type; physical_damage; knowledge_loss; supplier_loss; organizational_disruption; grievance; adaptation; international_legitimacy
algorithmic_change: Estimate conditional intervention outcomes and allow durable termination, delay, adaptation, or acceleration.
acceptance_test: Sensitivity analysis identifies conditions under which interdiction dominates, underperforms, or creates recurrence.

current_defect: Benefits, penalties, and restoration are treated as credible and nonstrategic.
required_state: bargain_stage; expected_late_offer; sanction_distribution; cure_credibility; restoration_vetoes; third_party_irreversibility
algorithmic_change: Add strategic delay, coalition effects, and partial or failed restoration.
acceptance_test: Model exposes cases where generous late deals encourage continued progress and where restoration failure suppresses disclosure.

current_defect: Alliance coverage is binary and static.
required_state: guarantee_credibility; in_theater_forces; economic_dependency; alliance_history; abandonment_risk; entrapment_risk; guarantor_bandwidth
algorithmic_change: Represent alliance assurance as stage-dependent and resource-constrained.
acceptance_test: Simultaneous crises reduce assurance credibility and alter proliferation choices in exposed allies.

current_defect: Technical findings have one confidence value and no institutional dissent or appeal.
required_state: evidence_packet; source_provenance; classification_level; majority_finding; minority_finding; appeal_time; conflict_of_interest
algorithmic_change: Model graded findings, dissent, compartmentation, appeal, and consequence-body misuse.
acceptance_test: Blind exercise detects intelligence laundering and preserves a documented minority finding without paralyzing urgent reversible action.

current_defect: Conversion reduces domestic resistance without preserving latent capability.
required_state: workforce_dependence; successor_mission_quality; facility_dual_use; expertise_retention; restart_time; political_veto_power; escrow_performance
algorithmic_change: Model conversion as both constituency shift and possible reconstitution asset.
acceptance_test: A conversion plan passes only if political support rises while conservative restart time does not fall below the response margin.

current_defect: Actors interact in one global abstract topology.
required_state: region; dyad; third_party_link; sanctuary; supplier_patron; local_doctrine; asymmetric_stakes; cross_theater_coupling
algorithmic_change: Use layered regional networks connected by suppliers, alliances, and great-power commitments.
acceptance_test: Leave-one-actor-out tests identify which excluded node resets each regional equilibrium.

current_defect: Safe zero is an endpoint condition, not a crisis-capable mobilization environment.
required_state: latent_mobilization; public_signal; secret_stock; preemption_pressure; rearmament_queue; alliance_reconstitution; withdrawal_clock
algorithmic_change: Add zero-world mobilization games and rearmament races.
acceptance_test: Operational zero fails if any plausible crisis produces a negative portfolio margin or first-mover advantage.

current_defect: Only states can initiate nuclear threat paths.
required_state: nonstate_actor; insider_access; theft_path; trafficking_network; sponsor_link; attribution_confidence; improvised_device_progress
algorithmic_change: Add nonstate and proxy threat objects that interact with state material-control systems.
acceptance_test: The system can prioritize and respond to simultaneous state breakout and material-theft threats without assuming a compliance bargain.

current_defect: Inspection effort does not depend on material type, facility count, access, or significant-quantity timeliness.
required_state: material_type; significant_quantity; facility_count; access_delay; inspection_frequency; monitoring_coverage; anomaly_resolution_time
algorithmic_change: Add risk-informed safeguards effort and resource-allocation optimization.
acceptance_test: Inspection schedules meet declared timeliness targets under finite capacity and changing facility portfolios.

current_defect: Status and legitimacy are secondary scalar incentives.
required_state: norm_internalization; taboo_strength; perceived_hierarchy; legal_legitimacy; status_substitute; identity_consistency
algorithmic_change: Allow normative and identity mechanisms to independently cause restraint or resistance.
acceptance_test: Model can produce restraint without material inducement and rejection of materially favorable unequal bargains.

current_defect: Simulation output is summarized as regime probability without external-validity controls.
required_state: model_version; calibration_source; parameter_uncertainty; structural_variant; game_design; participant_type; replication_status
algorithmic_change: Create model ensemble, pre-registration, sensitivity dashboard, and explicit forecast prohibition.
acceptance_test: Every headline result can be traced to assumptions and survives or fails transparently across structural variants.

current_defect: Federated institutions are treated as complementary without seam failure.
required_state: mandate_overlap; mandate_gap; veto_point; forum_shopping; emergency_owner; appeal_owner; timeout_owner
algorithmic_change: Model authority routing and failure at every inter-institution interface.
acceptance_test: Every anomaly reaches one accountable owner or triggers a documented hold; no seam permits silent expiry.

current_defect: The proposed compact's marginal value over the existing regime is assumed.
required_state: existing_regime_service; proposed_service; duplication_cost; legitimacy_gain; sponsor_loss; transition_risk
algorithmic_change: Add a function-by-function institutional marginal-value comparison.
acceptance_test: No new body is created unless it closes a measured gap that cannot be repaired inside an existing institution.
